entities.summary: Kareem AJ Hunt is an American professional football running back for the Kansas City Chiefs of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Toledo Rockets and was selected by the Chiefs in the third round of the 2017 NFL draft. Hunt also played for the Cleveland Browns.
